description:
This protocol performs a custom PCR preparation for gel samples using an on-deck Opentrons Thermocycler module.



Opentrons Thermocycler (occupying slots 7, 8, 10, 11) with NEST 0.1 mL 96-Well PCR Plate, Full Skirt
Opentrons Temperature Module with USA Scientific 96 Deep Well Plate 2.4 mL
Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat
Opentrons 20µl and 50/300µl tipracks



96-deepwell reagent block on temperature module (slot 4)
 well A1: DNTPs
 well B1: polymerase
 column 2: PCR buffer
 wells A3-H3: templates 1-8
* column 4: water

labware.name: reagent plate on Temperature Module GEN1 on 4
reaction plate on Thermocycler Module on 7
